lanes.notes: Runs eight exact same-fixture cases against streamdown@2.5.0 and the four pinned official React plugin packages. The streaming and controls cases assert exact upstream and Octane outcomes for three documented upstream corrections, then remove only those identified element attributes before comparing the remaining DOM. Native-event and consolidated-plugin Octane contracts remain ordinary package tests outside parity evidence.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 2.5.0 shares animation progress across sibling blocks, producing 0ms durations for later sibling text.
divergences.octaneResult: Each streaming block tracks progress independently, producing 100ms durations and a 40ms third-fragment delay in the pinned fixture.
divergences.rationale: Per-block progress prevents one completed block from suppressing animation in a newly appended sibling.
divergences.consumerImpact: Appended sibling blocks animate independently instead of inheriting another block's completed progress.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Expect newly appended blocks to receive their own configured animation timing.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream isolates animation state per block.

divergences.upstreamResult: Version 2.5.0 emits unbalanced Tailwind arbitrary-value code-block background classes and leaves icon size props as inert SVG attributes at 16x16.
divergences.octaneResult: Code-block background classes use balanced closing parentheses, and built-in icons consume size into exact width and height attributes without an inert size attribute.
divergences.rationale: Balanced arbitrary-value syntax is required for Tailwind recognition, and the declared icon size should control rendered dimensions.
divergences.consumerImpact: Code-block theme backgrounds scan correctly, and control icons render at the requested 14px or 20px dimensions instead of always 16px.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Include the Octane package source in the Tailwind content scan and account for requested icon sizes in pixel-sensitive styling.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream balances the class strings and consumes icon size into dimensions.
